concept.title: Leverage watchdog devices for Self Node Remediation
concept.shortdesc: The Self Node Remediation Operator determines the remediation strategy based on the watchdog devices that are present.

conbody.p: If a hardware watchdog device is configured and available, the Operator uses it for remediation. If a hardware watchdog device is not configured, the Operator enables and uses a softdog device for remediation.
If neither watchdog devices are supported, either by the system or by the configuration, the Operator remediates nodes by using software reboot.
